Fig. 3. Overview of the RVAF architecture. Given a task instruction and multi-view images, RVAF first encodes them into task embeddings and view-specific embeddings. These embeddings are then processed through intra-view and inter-view AmpAttention to capture view representations. The resulting representations are used to predict the next key-frame pose.
